sentences.en: He has excellent techniques which would outdo a specialist.
sentences.zh: 他有出色的技术，足以超越专家。

sentences.en: They are constantly trying to outdo each other.
sentences.zh: 他们总是试图胜过对方。

sentences.en: Nobody can outdo my generosity, but I am only a little boastful.
sentences.zh: 没有人能超过我的慷慨，但我只是有点自夸。
